Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1114
Claimant:
Jodi Sanchez
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
11/04/2023
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant has
retained counsel, and all further contact is to go through the attorney's office.
12/02/2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage perdates the policy start.
01/02/2024
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show damage consistent with the described impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so photos are the main visual record for now.
02/03/2024
Police report places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of collision, and the responding officer's notes match the
account given to us. Vehicle damage aligns with the reported point and force of impact.
02/05/2024
Counsel submitted the initial injury summary, reporting neck strain. The reported injury fits the kind and force of a
rear-end impact of this type.
02/19/2024
Claimant's account was given in a recorded call and again in the follow-up interview, and the core details were the
same both times. Requested the medical records and itemized bills from the treating provider.
05/19/2024
Medical records show no prior treatment to the neck or upper back, and our index search returned no earlier claims
for the same body area.
05/26/2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for a neck strain of this severity. Requested the treating
physician's notes explaining the expected recovery timeline and the reasons for continued visits.
06/14/2024
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history and found no earlier damage on record. The repair estimate is being
checked against the photos and the reported impact.
06/27/2024
Sent a status letter to counsel lsiting outstanding items: the physician's treatment notes, the final itemized bills, and
the repair invoice. Will reassess once these are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
